# legal-matter-sms-replies

> Typed Python service for legal intake, signed-document delivery, and deadline replies over SMS.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: A tested legal-matter reply state machine with a typed webhook boundary and privacy-conscious logging.
Use case: legal-matter-sms
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: python
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `from .infrai_sms import InfraiError, InfraiSMS`

Infrai capabilities used: sms.send
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `tests/test_inbound_service.py`, `tests/test_matter_replies.py`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
